title: Vallee in James Fox film: AI created by a non-human intelligence

tellings.quote: and I think he said this recently in the the James Fox thing that he did, we may be engaging with an artificial intelligence, which in turn has been created by a non-human intelligence from another planet.

plain: Humanity may be dealing with an artificial intelligence, which was itself built by a non-human intelligence from another planet. A UFO researcher named Jason Simosa says that Jacques Vallée, a veteran researcher of the UFO question, said this recently in a film by the documentary maker James Fox. Simosa passes it on to Michels from memory, as something Vallée said, not something he says himself.
